result.card: This PR adds functional test coverage in rpc_psbt.py to verify that combinepsbt preserves unknown key-value pairs across global, input, and output maps. It tests both PSBTv0 and PSBTv2 across identical keys, distinct keys, asymmetric fields, and conflicting values. The change addresses missing test coverage for PSBT merging logic. The author notes this test was suggested during review of PR 34893 and continues work from PR 35310.
